extracts.title: GO (Ms) No. 53: Haj-Pilgrimage -Government servants proceeding for Haj pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia - Exemption from obtaining No objection Certificate for those proceeding to Haj either through Tamil Nadu State Haj committee or through private Tour operators - orders - issued - Amendment -orders-issued.
extracts.text:
ABSTRACT

!-laj Pilgrimage Government servants proceeding for Haj Pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia - Exemption from obtaining No objection Certificate for those proceeding to Haj either through Tamil Nadu state Haj committee or through Private Tour operators - orders - Issued- Amendment - Orders - Issued.

Backward classes. Most Backward classes and Minorities

Welfare (S1) Department

G.O. (Ms) No.53 Dated L3.O7.2O2O Sarvari, Aani 29 Thiruvalluvar Aandu 2051

Read :

1. G.O. (Ms) No.132, Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare (S1) Department, dated 20.tI.20L2. 2. From the Secretary and Executive Officer, Tamil Nadu State Haj Committee Letter No.332/H C/20L9, dated 29.t0.20L9.

k** ** ORDER:

In the Government Order first read above, orders were issued that the Government servants proceeding on Haj pilgrimage to saudi Arabia either through Tamil Nadu State Haj Committee or through

Private Tour operators on temporary Haj passports with a validity of not exceeding twelve months (for saudi Arabia) are exempted from obtaining "Identity certificate" for grant for passport. The Government servants who proceed for Umrah/Haj pilgrimage to saudi Arabia either through Tamil Nadu state Haj committee / Private Tour operators shall also be exempted from obtaining 'No Objection Certificate'.

2. The Secretary and Executive Officer, Tamil Nadu State Haj committee in his letter second read above has stated that the Ministry of External Affairs has made regular international passports mandatory for general public including Government Servants for Haj Pilgrimage from the year 20L3 and hence the portion relating to temporary Haj passports may be deleted and to retain the portion relating to 'No Objection Certificate' in the Government Order first read above.

2

3. The Government have examined the request of the Secretary and Executive officer, Tamil Nadu state Haj Committee and decided to amend the Government Order first read above as follows:

Amendment

For the existing paragraph 4 of the Government Order first read above, the following shall be substituted:-

"4. The Government have carefully examined the proposal of the Secretary & Executive officer, Tamil Nadu State Haj Committee and in partial modification of the Government order second mentioned in Government order first read above, Government direct that the Government servants who proceed for Umrah / Haj Pilgrimage to saudi Arabia either through Tamil Nadu state Haj committee or through Private Tour operators shall be exempted from obtaining'No Objection Certificate' ".

5. This order issue with the concurrence of personner and Administrative Reforms Department vide its U.o.No. L5g6o/AL/
